name: Data Safe
description: Tryna be the best data saving mod out on Geode.

show-notifications.name: Show Notifications
show-notifications.description: Toggle toast message notifications at the bottom of the screen.

auto-cloud-backup.name: Auto Boomlings Backup
auto-cloud-backup.description: Periodically trigger secure cloud backups to your active GD account.

test-save-btn.name: Run Test Save & Notification
test-save-btn.description: Flip this switch to force a local backup and sync to Boomlings.

open-folder-btn.name: Open Save File Folder
open-folder-btn.description: Opens your specific mod sandbox save folder in your file explorer.

export-backup-btn.name: Export Backup File
export-backup-btn.description: Flip to export your Data Safe backup to your mod directory.

import-backup-btn.name: Import & Restore Backup
import-backup-btn.description: Opens a system window to pick and import an external save file (.dat / .bak).
